$comment: Pins the RaTeX Apple integration for vendor-ratex.mjs. Instead of React Native's spm_dependency (which builds/signs RaTeX's Swift wrapper from SPM source at build time and caused #491/#527), we vendor the prebuilt static XCFramework plus RaTeX's four core Swift sources and KaTeX fonts into packages/react-native-enriched-markdown/ios/vendor/ (gitignored, reproduced on demand, shipped in the npm tarball via prepack). Same mechanism as the tree-sitter runtime pin in grammar-versions.json. To re-pin: bump tag, download the two assets, run `node vendor/vendor-ratex.mjs --force`, and paste the sha256 it prints on mismatch. The swiftSources list mirrors erweixin/RaTeX's RaTeXCore.podspec; PlatformCompat.swift and RaTeXView.swift are intentionally omitted (the four files typecheck standalone and pull in no React Native/UI surface).
